subject: angol
title: At the pharmacy on holiday
instructionsHu: Skóciai nyaralás közben megbetegedtél. Menj be egy gyógyszertárba, írd le a tüneteidet, és kérj tanácsot a gyógyszerésztől. Minden pontot teljesíts.

situation.context: You are on holiday in Edinburgh with your family. Since yesterday evening you have had a sore throat, a headache and a slight temperature. You go into a pharmacy near your hotel to ask for advice.
situation.candidateRole: You are a tourist who feels ill.
goals: Describe your symptoms and say how long you have had them.
Answer the pharmacist's questions about allergies or other medicine.
Ask how often you should take the medicine.
Ask what else you can do to get better quickly and whether you need to see a doctor.
situation.examinerOpening: Good afternoon. What can I do for you?

followUpQuestions: I see. Are you allergic to anything, or are you taking any other medicine?
These tablets should help. Do you have any questions about them?
Is there anything else I can help you with?

usefulPhrases.en: I've got a sore throat and a headache.
usefulPhrases.hu: Fáj a torkom és a fejem.

usefulPhrases.en: I think I've got a temperature.
How many times a day should I take them?
Can I take them before meals?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Good afternoon. What can I do for you?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Good afternoon. I'm on holiday here with my family, and I don't feel very well. I've had a sore throat and a headache since yesterday evening, and I think I've got a slight temperature too.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: I see. Are you allergic to anything, or are you taking any other medicine?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: No, I'm not allergic to anything, as far as I know. And I'm not taking any other medicine at the moment.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Good. These tablets should help with the headache and the temperature. Do you have any questions about them?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, how often should I take them? And should I take them before or after meals?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: One tablet every six hours, but no more than four a day. It's best to take them after a meal.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Thank you. Is there anything else I can do to get better quickly? And do you think I need to see a doctor?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Drink plenty of warm drinks and get lots of rest. If you still have a temperature in three days, you should see a doctor.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: OK, I'll do that. Thank you very much for your help. How much are the tablets?

notes: Kommunikációs cél: a vizsgázó sorban mind a négy szempontot teljesíti – leírja a tüneteit és azt, hogy mióta tartanak, válaszol az allergiára vonatkozó kérdésre, megkérdezi az adagolást, végül tanácsot kér, és azt is, kell-e orvoshoz mennie –, és udvariasan zárja le a vásárlást.
Szókincs: a betegség és a gyógyszertár szavai pontosak (sore throat, headache, slight temperature, allergic to, tablets, after meals).

Nyelvhelyesség: a mióta tartó tünetet helyesen befejezett jelen idő fejezi ki a „since” szóval (I've had a sore throat … since yesterday evening), a kérdések szórendje hibátlan (How often should I take them?).
Érdemes megtanulni: „I don't feel very well.”, „I've had a sore throat since yesterday evening”, „as far as I know”, „Is there anything else I can do to get better quickly?”.
